checks.detail: cfg(test) exact libtest child invokes the actual CLI foreground::run and shared LoadedJob::VirtualServer, not a reimplemented echo loop.
Fresh CA and independent server/client leaf keys, proper EKUs, server DNS SAN, client leaf pin ACL for the two exact profiles; actual TLS catalog/import peers retained until after child termination.

Catalog exactly 2 expected stable keys; each standard IMPORT then successful actual SET_CONFIGURATION1; each pending IN submitted; snapshot exactly 2 expected bus/profile entries, leased=true/configuration1/pending1/queues0; each real TLS data stream remains pending for40ms.

4096-byte pipe; parent read side only nonblocking; child stdout inherits shared blocking writer OFD; padding reopens the parent-owned writer through /proc/self/fd as independent NONBLOCK OFD, writes one byte until EAGAIN and FIONREAD4096; flags independently checked; actual child task pipe_write observed.
Output.frozen forbids any read after fill; wait(false) retains no-drain condition; final FIONREAD remains4096, no blocked terminal snapshot fabricated.

Only unreaped direct child PID is signalled; ready/blocked INT+TERM demand code0, no-signal blocked timeout demands code1 plus stdout deadline diagnostic; no automatic retry, per-case failure immediately terminates matrix.

Ready cases require exactly one actual stopped snapshot with both leases/pending/configuration/queues zero. Blocked cases deliberately prove cooperative process exit and TLS closure only, not backend cleanup snapshot, helper or USB restoration.
Consumed stdout and parsed events plus stderr and FAIL summary retained; failed Owner Drop kills/waits only as cleanup and never changes FAIL to PASS.

Server/client private DER exists only in private TempDir files created0600 and memory; evidence directory receives no key file, private DER hash or credential JSON. Child errors are fixed/typed adapter errors; stdout captures only safe real backend snapshots/events.

Memory-DER loaded config is explicitly test-only and bypasses trusted root file loader. No root policy/driver/module/USB/QEMU coverage claimed. Effective UID nonzero checked, capabilities not measured by these test fixtures.

limitations: No tests, Cargo, CLI, QEMU or child processes were run by reviewer. Parent integrated execution is separate evidence.
The parent test contains five lifecycle scenarios; the exact child fixture is another libtest item that normally performs no work without its marker. Do not equate scenarios with USB hardware cases.
On failure actual_child_status is based on ExitStatus::code(): null alone cannot distinguish a signal exit from a still-running process. This affects diagnostics, not strict success codes.

The no-signal4..7-second assertion starts before synthetic pipe fill; it includes setup/scheduling overhead and is a bounded observation of the actual5-second output policy, not a precise independent event-call start/end measurement.
